# Remotax — Global Remote Work Financial Intelligence Platform

> Precision cross-border statutory tax calculations, net take-home pay, and relocation intelligence for remote employees, contractors, and digital nomads across sovereign jurisdictions for tax year 2026.

## Modern Statutory Country Hubs
- [Spain Remote Worker Tax Calculator 2026](https://afrix.ir/remotax/countries/spain/): Official 2026 Spanish IRPF progressive rates, 24% Beckham Law flat rate, and €61,214.40 social security base máxima.
- [Portugal Remote Worker Tax Calculator 2026](https://afrix.ir/remotax/countries/portugal/): Official 2026 Portuguese IRS progressive scale, 20% IFICI regime, and Category B simplified self-employed regime.
- [UAE Dubai Remote Worker Tax Calculator 2026](https://afrix.ir/remotax/countries/uae/): Official 0% federal personal income tax, Virtual Working Programme, and AED exchange parity.
- [Italy Remote Worker Tax Calculator 2026](https://afrix.ir/remotax/countries/italy/): Official 2026 Italian IRPEF progressive brackets, 50% Impatriati exemption (D.Lgs. 209/2023), and INPS massimale ceiling.
- [Thailand Remote Worker Tax Calculator 2026](https://afrix.ir/remotax/countries/thailand/): Official progressive PIT, 5-year Destination Thailand Visa (DTV), and territorial remittance framework under Por. 161/2566.

## Special Expatriate Tax Regimes
- [Spain Beckham Law 2026 Statutory Guide](https://afrix.ir/remotax/regimes/beckham-law-spain/): Ley 28/2022 24% flat tax for inbound remote workers up to €600,000.
- [Portugal IFICI Innovation Tax Regime 2026](https://afrix.ir/remotax/regimes/ifici-portugal/): Art. 58-A EBF 20% flat tax for qualifying international talent.
- [Dubai Virtual Working Programme 2026](https://afrix.ir/remotax/regimes/dubai-virtual-working-programme/): 1-year renewable zero-tax remote residency.
- [Italy Impatriati Expat Tax Regime 2026](https://afrix.ir/remotax/regimes/impatriati-italy/): D.Lgs. 209/2023 50% taxable income exemption up to €600,000.
- [Thailand Destination Thailand Visa (DTV) 2026](https://afrix.ir/remotax/regimes/thailand-dtv/): 5-year multi-entry digital nomad visa with 180-day stay periods.
